headline: "Iran Is Losing Influence Over Hormuz"… Crude Oil Shipments Recover to 80% of Pre-War Levels
summary: Gulf oil producers, backed by US Navy support, are rapidly increasing crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, according to CNN. Traffic has recovered to about 80% of pre-war levels.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne crude oil. Recovery in flows affects global oil supply and prices.
why_moved: Crude shipments through Hormuz have recovered to about 80% of pre-war levels, easing supply concerns.
